BSES Yamuna Power Limited,** Shakti Kiran Building, Karkardooma, New Delhi - 110032. ** Respondents** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Order in IA No. 126/2025 In Petition No. 192/MP/2021 1** of **4** Page **1** of **4** ## **Parties Present:** Shri Sourav Roy, Advocate, SBSR Shri Devansh Pundir, Advocate, SBSR Ms. Lavanya Panwar, Advocate, SBSR Shri Lakshyajit Singh Bagdwal, Advocate, SBSR Shri Harshit Singh, Advocate, SBSR Ms. Somya Sahni, Advocate, SECI Shri Venkatesh, Advocate, TPDDL Ms. Priya Dhankar, Advocate, TPDDL Shri Punyam Bhutani, Advocate, TPDDL ## **ORDER** SBSR Power Cleantech Eleven Private Limited (hereinafter referred to as “SBSR/Petitioner”) (now known as Adani Solar Jaisalmer Two Private Limited) has filed the instant Interlocutory Application (hereinafter referred to as “IA”) seeking direction upon the Respondent No. 1 i.e., Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited (hereinafter referred to as “SECI”) to accept the request of the Petitioner to replace the existing Performance Bank Guarantee bearing No. 2158001515321 with a new Performance Bank Guarantee to be furnished by the said applicant/ petitioner, amongst other reliefs. 2. The Petitioner has made the following prayers in the IA: - _a. Direct SECI to accept and acknowledge the new Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) bearing No. 03189GPCA2525402 dated 16.09.2025 (with Canara Bank Limited), for all purposes under the PPA dated 20.08.2019;_ - _b. Consequently, direct SECI to return the Performance Bank Guarantee with Bank of Baroda being BG no. 2158IGP001515321 to Petitioner;_ - _c. Direct SECI to allow and permit the assignment of the Petitioner’s rights and obligations under Article 15.1 of the PPA (to the extent of present PPA capacity of 150 MW) in favour of Canara Bank Limited; and_ - _d. Pass any other order or order(s) as this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the present case._ ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Order in IA No. 126/2025 In Petition No. 192/MP/2021 2** of **4** Page **2** of **4** 3. It is stated that Petition No. 192/MP/2021 has been filed by the Petitioner _inter alia_ seeking a direction that it is not liable to pay any liquidated damages or other penalties corresponding to reduced capacity of 150 MW which stands commissioned under the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) and the short-closed balance capacity of 150 MW shelved out of PPA on account of the delay which are not attributable to the Petitioner for both capacities. In the Petition, the Petitioner has also sought relief for the return of the Performance Bank Guarantee(s) furnished to the Respondent, SECI. The Pleadings and arguments in the Petition have already been concluded, and the order was reserved by the Commission on 7.7.2025. 4. The Performance Bank Guarantee furnished by the Petitioner, which is a part of the Petition, has been issued by the Bank of Baroda. However, in the meantime, Petitioner has now entered into an arrangement with a new Bank, namely Canara Bank, and accordingly, it seeks to replace the earlier Performance Bank Guarantee bearing No. 2158IGP001515321 (issued by Bank of Baroda) with a new Performance Bank Guarantee issued by Canara Bank, bearing No. 03189GPCA2525402 in favour of SECI. The Petitioner, _vide_ its communication dated 23.9.2025, requested SECI to accept the new Performance Bank Guarantee and return the old one. However, since the Petition was pending and there was a specific prayer _qua_ the earlier Performance Bank Guarantee, SECI expressed its difficulty towards replacing the earlier Performance Bank Guarantee. 5. The IA was listed for hearing on 12.2.2026. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner, while reiterating the submissions made in the IA, pointed out that the Performance Bank Guarantee issued by Bank of Baroda was valid only ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Order in IA No. 126/2025 In Petition No. 192/MP/2021 3** of **4** Page **3** of **4** up to 15.2.2026, and since the final order in the Petition was yet to be passed, the Petitioner should be allowed to replace this earlier Performance Bank Guarantee with the new one. 6. However, in view of the observation of the Commission that the order in the Petition will be passed before 15.2.2026, the learned counsel fairly stated that, in that case, the Petitioner does not wish to pursue the reliefs prayed for in the IA. Subsequently, on 12.2.2026 itself, a common order was passed in Petition Nos. 192/MP/2021 and 235/MP/2023. Accordingly, as stated by the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the ground for which the IA was moved no longer survives. Thus, the IA is disposed of as such. 7. IA No.126/2025 in Petition No. 192/MP/2021 is disposed of in terms of the above. Sd/sd/sd/sd/- **(Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.)
